scoring_method.rule: A criterion receives 1 only when every required clause is explicitly satisfied; any missing clause yields 0. No absent detail is inferred and prose quality receives no credit.

improvement.material_behavior_improvement_rule: Forward case score exceeds the frozen baseline case score by at least one strict criterion.

forward_valid_basis: All attempt-2 integrity checks pass. The frozen strict score is 20/25 versus the frozen 1/25 baseline, a +0.76 normalized delta, and every case gains at least two strict criteria.
